pw.title: Set your password
rack.conflict_body: It arrived when room {room} was already booked {from} → {to}. The booking is still accepted and sits in the "Unassigned" lane. Suggested free rooms: {rooms}.
rack.dep_unconfirmed: Room {room}: guest {guest} checks out today, check-out time not confirmed (reminded at {time}).
rack.hidden_note: Cancelled and no-show bookings aren't shown. Rooms off sale show "Off sale" at the start of the row.
rack.legend_kit: Guest over standard occupancy – prepare extra amenity kit
rack.offline: You're offline. Data as of {time} – reconnecting. Bookings can't be created or changed to avoid double booking.
rooms.below_body: These bookings already have more guests. Change their guest count or move them to another room first.
rooms.capacity_help: Standard: guests included in the price. Maximum: standard + guests sleeping on the sofa. Children under 6 don't count.
rooms.footnote: Nightly list price = monthly price ÷ 12, rounded to 1,000 (BR-101) – calculated by the system. Price changes have an effective date; existing bookings and quotes keep the old price (BR-006).
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.rule_note: Guests over the standard occupancy sleep on the sofa, pay the extra-guest charge (BR-110) and get an extra amenity kit: 1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush, toiletries (no pillow).
rooms.snapshot_note: Bookings, quotes and leases created before the effective date keep the old price.
rooms.stop_help: Off = stop selling: the room disappears from the booking form and the rack shows "Off sale". Existing bookings stay.
rooms.subtitle: {rooms} rooms · {groups} groups
rsv.assign_effect: After assigning: the booking leaves the "Unassigned" lane, the red alert clears, and check-in works as normal.
rsv.assign_lead: Agoda sent a {group} booking for {from} → {to} when room {room} was already booked. Pick a free room – suggestions are sorted by fewest orphan nights.
rsv.cancel_rule: Cancelled {days} days ahead: {pct}% of the deposit is refunded (BR-309).
rsv.child_note: Children: only the year of birth – no guest profile, no contact details stored.
rsv.deposit_partial: You can still record the amount received – the booking stays "On hold · awaiting deposit" and shows what's missing.
rsv.extend_rule: Up to +{hours} hours and no later than {time} on the arrival day. Can be extended only once.
rsv.fit_gap: Leaves {n} empty night(s) before the stay
rsv.hold_auto: If no deposit by then, the system cancels the hold and puts the room back on sale.
rsv.kit_task: Housekeeping task: 1 kit (1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush, toiletries – no pillow) before {time} · Assigned
rsv.party_missing: {n} guest(s) missing – everyone is needed for the residence registration.
rsv.reason_ota_conflict: OTA booking arrived when the room was full
rsv.reconcile_note: Manually recorded transfers are flagged "awaiting reconciliation" until accounting matches the bank statement.
rsv.upgrade_note: Rooms in another group are suggestions only – the front-desk lead or manager confirms.
sale.commission: Sales earns ({pct}% of room charges – BR-903)
sale.commission_ctv: You earn ({pct}% of room charges – BR-903)
sale.deposit_due: Deposit to hold the room ({pct}% of room charges – BR-305)
sale.hold_next: Send the QR code to the guest. You'll get a reminder {hours} hours before it expires.
sale.hold_until: Expires {time} – without a deposit it's cancelled and the room goes back on sale.
sale.month_note: Monthly stays need a lease – still done outside the app; ask the front desk to hold the room with a manual long-stay booking.
sale.none_body: Try shifting by 1 day: {dates} has 2 rooms.
sale.offline: You're offline – results may be out of date. Quotes can't be made yet.
sale.price_source: Direct rate from today's rate calendar (BR-104). The quote holds the price for {days} days.
sale.qr_after: The QR code uses the booking ID as the transfer note and is created right after the hold.
sale.room_meta: Standard {base} · max {max} (guest {max} sleeps on the sofa)
sale.today_handoff: Sales/agents: ask the front desk to create a paid booking for this guest.
sale.quote_text:
OTTIMO Boutique Stay – Quote {code}
Room {room} {room_name}, {from} → {to} ({nights} nights), {guests}.
Room total: {room_total}{discount_note}.
Deposit to hold the room: {deposit}. The rest is paid at check-in.
This quote is valid until {expires}.
sale.quote_text_extra_guest: Includes extra-guest charge for {n} guest(s) on the sofa: {amount}.
shell.no_access_body: This page is for another role. If you need it, ask the owner to add the role to your account.
shell.no_access_title: You don't have access to this page
shell.offline_desk: You're offline. Data as of {time} – view only; bookings can't be created or changed.
shell.offline_readonly: You're offline. Data as of {time} – view only; changes can't be saved yet.
shell.subtitle: {property} · {date}
today.dep_unconfirmed: check-out time not confirmed · reminded at {time}
today.empty_body: No arrivals, departures, registrations or holds to handle. Open the room rack to take new bookings.
today.kit_body: {n} guest(s) over standard sleeping on the sofa: 1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush and toiletries (no pillow). Task sent to housekeeping.
today.kit_title: Prepare extra amenity kit – room {room}, before {time}
today.money_after_cancel_body: The hold was cancelled automatically before the money arrived. Contact the guest: rebook if a room is free, or refund (manager approval needed).
users.more_help: "More…": Reset password (creates a temporary password), Lock account, Reset 2-step verification.
users.role_desc.collaborator: Sees only their own quotes, bookings and guests; can't confirm deposits.
users.role_desc.front_desk: Bookings, check-in/out, payments, registration on approved devices.
users.role_desc.front_desk_lead: Front desk + approves comps within limits, passes room inspections.
users.role_desc.housekeeping: Cleaning tasks, room inspection, issue reports on the phone.
users.role_desc.maintenance: Work orders, blocking rooms for repair.
users.role_desc.manager: Approves refunds, credit, no-show restores; sees financial reports.
users.role_desc.sales_staff: Quotes, holds, confirming deposits on own bookings.
users.roles_effect: Changes apply when this person signs in again. Their open sessions will be signed out.
users.temp_pw_note: The system creates a temporary password, shown once so you can hand it to the user in person. They must change it at first sign-in.
msg.booking_confirmed: Hi {name}, OTTIMO confirms booking {code}: room {room}, {from} → {to} ({nights} nights). Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Deposit paid {deposit}, {balance} due at check-in. Cancellation: {cancel_policy_short}. Check in online for a faster arrival: {link}
msg.deposit_received: Hi {name}, OTTIMO has received your deposit of {deposit} for booking {code} (room {room}, {from} → {to}). {balance} is due at check-in. Cancellation: {cancel_policy_short}
msg.checkin_link: Hi {name}, to speed up your check-in, please send your IDs and arrival time here: {link} (about 2 minutes).
msg.checkout_reminder: Hi {name}, tomorrow {date} is your check-out day (by 12:00). Would you like to stay longer or check out late? Reply here: {link}
msg.bill: Thank you for staying at OTTIMO, {name}. Folio {bill_no}: {amount}. Details: {link}
msg.utility_bill: Hi {name}, your utilities bill for {period}: electricity {kwh} kWh, water {m3} m³, total {amount}, due {due}. Meter photos and details: {link}
msg.house_rules_smoking: Hi {name}, a friendly reminder: smoking is allowed on the balcony only. Smoking indoors incurs an odour-treatment fee under our house rules. Thank you!
msg.hot_water_issue: Hi {name}, we've received your report of no hot water in room {room}. Our technician will be there by {time}. Sorry for the inconvenience!
